Chords RS and QT are approximately horizontal, and chords QS and RT are two intersecting diagonal chords. In the figure at point Q, the angle formed by QS and QT is labeled 32°; what is asked for is the angle at point R formed by RS and RT. There are also angle labels (5x+4)° and (6x-2)°, but they do not need to be used to find ∠R in this problem. Then reason: ∠SQT is an inscribed angle and intercepts arc ST. ∠SRT is also an inscribed angle and likewise intercepts arc ST.
